description: Angular component for configuring math functions in a rule node within the Thingsboard platform. Defines form controls, validation, and logic for handling math operation configurations.

classes.name: MathFunctionConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent, managing a form for math function configuration in rule nodes.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the current form group for the math function configuration.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Updates form validators and control states based on selected operation and result type.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Returns list of form control names that trigger validation updates.
